subject: upk_package_header
claim: CookedPCConsole packages start with magic 0x9E2A83C1 and specify file version 860+
evidence_criteria: Inspection of ChaosGame/CookedPCConsole package binary headers

subject: lzo_chunk_compression
claim: Packages with PKG_Compressed flag use LZO chunked compression with uncompressed/compressed chunk tables
evidence_criteria: Inspection of package compression chunk headers in CookedPCConsole

subject: ue3_network_magic
claim: Multiplayer UDP connection follows UE3 bit-packed bunch framing over Channel 0 (Control) and Channel 2+ (Actor)
evidence_criteria: Packet traces and UNetConnection protocol specification

subject: mcts_tcp_framing

evidence_criteria: REA / Ghidra decompilation of CPackCoder::Decode (0x18002c570, evidence ev_e5b26e8ebfe414ea3b3e755432cd178aa7ea4f1ed4db59342a86383e8c7293fe)

subject: client_cli_overrides
claim: Paladins ShippingPC-ChaosGame.exe supports native CLI redirection flags (-host=, -tcp=, -servicediscoveryhost=, -dumpallmar) for local backend testing
evidence_criteria: String inspection and binary analysis of ShippingPC-ChaosGame.exe at offset 51257616-51258128

subject: cpack_udp_wire_framing
claim: CPackUdp on port 7777 uses a 570-byte minimum datagram for HelloSend with Function ID 0 at offset +0x5a, SHA-256 HMAC over 524 bytes at +0x26a, and negotiated MTU 1414 bytes
evidence_criteria: REA / Ghidra decompilation of CPackUdpDrv::DoHello (0x18004c3f0, evidence ev_017e402eacb02b101262b026e37b90a439af662833dcc9731d177b65b682126c) and CPackUdpConn::SendGame (0x18004d7f0, evidence ev_1c0913d8b91d3250ae6fd4cf05d10c79374115f36a654d8192a0cbc4c904a847)

subject: ue3_shootingrange_handshake
claim: Client connects to Level URL ShootingRange?game=ChaosGame.ChaosGameInfo over Channel 0 NMT_Welcome (0x01) and opens Actor Channel 2 for PlayerController
evidence_criteria: Decompilation of ShippingPC-ChaosGame.exe UControlChannel::ReceivedBunch and string references at 0x18033a170-0x18033a310
